name: After § 30
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 30a. Insists that cohesion policy should remain under shared management and should not be mixed with other programmes under a ‘single plan’; strongly opposes the remodelling of it based on the RRF and the introduction of political pre-conditions under the pretext of a reform programme;
